learning_objective.title: Idle growth must not run while an operator objective is active, blocked, or missing success artifacts
learning_objective.lesson: Background growth/training is welcome only when MIM is truly idle. An unfinished operator objective with missing evidence is not idle time.
learning_objective.fix_hypothesis: The growth launcher records operator_phase/operator_objective but does not enforce a guard before launching the next growth objective.
expected_mim_tod_resolution: Inspect scripts/mim_tod_growth_autonomy_launcher.py or the owning runtime service.
Add or route through a guard that blocks growth launch when operator_phase is active/blocked/published_to_mim or required operator artifacts are missing.
Publish blocked/skipped growth status naming the active operator objective.
Return control to MIM-LAB-AWARENESS-HUMAN-INTERACTION-V1 and publish lab-awareness status.
validation: With operator objective active/blocked and lab artifacts missing, growth launcher writes state=skipped reason=active_operator_objective_not_idle.
No new MIM-GROWTH-* objective becomes MIM_OPERATOR_STATUS while lab-awareness remains incomplete.
MIM publishes MIM_LAB_AWARENESS_STATUS.latest.json or a real blocked_with_inspection artifact.

tod_codex_boundary: TOD/Codex monitor and guide. Do not implement the guard for MIM unless the operator explicitly changes the boundary.
